name: ribbon
description: A quiet band above the prompt: how much of your week and 5-hour usage is left, the context, and whether the prompt cache is warm or cold. Follows your theme, refreshes on account switch, and works with API keys and local models.

style.title: Style
style.description: full: labels, dot bars and reset times. minimal: numbers only, like 96% · 8% · warm 60m (week, 5-hour, context, cache).

colours.title: Colours
colours.description: full: Claude's coral and the theme's colours. muted: everything grey, colour only when a window runs low or the context fills up. off: no colour, warnings in bold.

show.title: Show
show.description: always, or only when it matters: a window under 25% left, a cold cache, or a context over 85%.

showFiveHour.title: Show the 5-hour window
showFiveHour.description: The rolling 5-hour usage window, when your plan has one.

showContext.title: Show the context
showContext.description: How full this conversation's context window is.

showCache.title: Show the cache
showCache.description: Whether the prompt cache is warm or cold, and the next message's price.

cacheLength.title: Cache length
cacheLength.description: How long the prompt cache lives. auto: 1 hour on a Claude plan, 5 minutes on an API key.
